author: CNN
description:
Rep. Hakeem Jeffries (D-NY) is leading the Democratic party’s counterpunch to President Donald Trump’s aggressive mid-decade redistricting push. He’s going all in with money, legal firepower and his own political capital to make sure no seat is left on the table for Democrats — forcing the party to abandon the left’s longtime moral opposition to party-line map meddling. 

0:00 Can Democrats gerrymander their way to a House majority? 
3:20 How much will Democrats spend to ensure themselves an electoral map advantage? 
4:45 Jeffries on Maryland’s state senate president standing in the way of Dems’ redistricting plan there 
8:15 Inside Politics panel reacts to Jeffries’ confidence on redistricting 


Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#HakeemJeffries #MidtermElections #News
title: Top Dem Jeffries goes all in on gerrymandering: ‘Whatever it takes’
